prerequisites.notes: Compilation passes. Spec verified. No checkstyle configured. 1 pre-existing Windows-flaky failure (LocalStorageProviderTest) unchanged.

findings.message: version field mapped with insertable=false/updatable=false and no @Version annotation — Hibernate will never perform optimistic locking checks on this entity.
findings.manualAction: Remove RewardBalance @Entity entirely (it is @Deprecated) OR add @Version and remove insertable=false/updatable=false.

findings.message: doCreditInTx and doCreditCompanyInTx use findForUpdate + orElseGet(save) with a TOCTOU window on first-credit. Mitigated by WalletService.withOptimisticRetry catching 23505, but requires DB unique constraint to be present.
findings.manualAction: Verify unique constraint on reward_wallets(client_id, user_id, currency_id, wallet_type) and (client_id, partner_company_id, currency_id, wallet_type) in migration SQL.

findings.message: reservedBalance and walletType mapped as insertable=false/updatable=false — silent write discard.
findings.manualAction: Acceptable short-term (@Deprecated). Migrate callers to RewardWallet.

findings.message: reserve(), debit(), release(), returnCredit() lacked @Transactional(NEVER) — ambient transactions could silently participate.
existsByRewardWalletId idempotency check is not atomic with the subsequent INSERT — full mitigation requires a DB unique constraint on ledger_entry(reward_wallet_id, reference_type, reference_id).
findings.manualAction: Add unique DB constraint on ledger_entry(reward_wallet_id, reference_type, reference_id) for fully-atomic idempotency.

findings.message: amount not validated before arithmetic — null or non-positive produces NPE or silent meaningless ledger entries.
findings.manualAction: Add Objects.requireNonNull(amount) and positive-amount guard to all mutating methods.

code-review.notes: 1 auto-fix: @Transactional(NEVER) now on all 6 mutation methods. WalletMutationDelegate reviewed. Critical TOCTOU mitigated at service layer; full fix requires DB constraint verification.

findings.message: hasRole() reads SecurityContextHolder — may hold wrong principal in async contexts.
AccessDeniedException throws not logged — financial access denials should be recorded for audit.
findings.manualAction: Add log.warn() before each AccessDeniedException throw.

security-review.notes: No controller/security/DTO changes in delta. Carried forward.

contract-compliance.notes: No controller or DTO changes in delta. All endpoints match reward-balances.yaml. Carried forward.

findings.summary: Retried non-credit wallet mutations can apply the same business event repeatedly
findings.details: reserve, debit, release, and returnCredit lacked idempotency guards matching doCreditInTx.
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — all four non-credit mutations now have the duplicate-reference guard (commit e005011)
findings.recommendation: Add existsByRewardWalletIdAndReferenceTypeAndReferenceId check before balance mutation in all non-credit methods.

findings.summary: Budget-utilization unique indexes can fail migration on existing duplicate rows
findings.details: V9 adds partial unique indexes to budget_utilizations; pre-existing duplicates would abort the Flyway migration.
findings.recommendation: Add a pre-migration deduplication step before CREATE UNIQUE INDEX.
